name: boardgame-io
title_zh: 用 boardgame.io 搭回合制桌游的脚手架
tagline_zh: 从井字棋到卡牌对战，写回合、阶段、AI 机器人，不用啃 v0.50 文档。报错时它直接告诉你哪步写歪了。
tagline_en: From tic-tac-toe to card battles, scaffold turns, phases, and bots without digging through v0.50 docs. Errors.
desc_en: Build turn-based games with the boardgame.io framework (v0.50.x API). Use whenever the user wants to create, extend, or debug a board/card/dice/strategy game with boardgame.io — e.g. "make tic-tac-toe / chess / a card game", "add multiplayer to my boardgame.io game", "define phases/moves/turns", writing bots, lobby/matchmaking, or any mention of boardgame.io, bgio, 回合制游戏, 桌游, 棋牌游戏, 桌面游戏开发. Covers
why_zh: 它把 boardgame.io 的 API 拆成可复用的积木，按你的规则自动生成合法代码。
why_en: It decomposes the boardgame.io API into reusable blocks, auto-generates valid code for your rules, and pinpoints errors to.
limit_zh: 只认 v0.50.x API，旧版项目需先迁移；只覆盖回合制桌游，实时或非棋牌类游戏不适用；生成的代码是起点。
limit_en: Only v0.50.x API; older projects need migration. Turn-based board/card games only—no real-time or non-tabletop. Generated code is a starting point.
